title: Normal 3-vehicle loop
description: The original process, now driven by the backend: one vehicle runs a cycle at a time (Stop 1 -> load at Stop 2 -> unload at Stop 3), hands the next cycle over to the next vehicle with the V2V handover negotiation, then drives the return leg back to Stop 1.

timeline.text: Three vehicles at Stop 1; Vehicle #1 starts the first cycle.
